   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

rVacDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_mbar);

    bVacA_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bVacA_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar < -25.0) OR (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar > 0.5) THEN
    bVacB_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bVacB_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar < -25.0) OR (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar > 0.5) THEN
    bVacC_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bVacC_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Cross-Channel Drift & Discrepancy Isolation *)
IF bVacA_Healthy AND bVacB_Healthy AND (rVacDiscrepancy_AB > rVacuumTolerance_mbar) THEN
    IF rVacDiscrepancy_CA > rVacuumTolerance_mbar THEN
        bVacA_Healthy := FALSE; (* Ch A deviates from both B and C -> Isolate Channel A *)
    ELSIF rVacDiscrepancy_BC > rVacuumTolerance_mbar THEN
        bVacB_Healthy := FALSE; (* Ch B deviates from both A and C -> Isolate Channel B *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bVacB_Healthy AND bVacC_Healthy AND (rVacDiscrepancy_BC > rVacuumTolerance_mbar) THEN
    IF (rVacDiscrepancy_CA > rVacuumTolerance_mbar) AND bVacA_Healthy THEN
        bVacC_Healthy := FALSE; (* Ch C deviates from both A and B -> Isolate Channel C *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Tally Healthy Channels *)
iVacHealthyCount := 0;
IF bVacA_Healthy THEN iVacHealthyCount := iVacHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bVacB_Healthy THEN iVacHealthyCount := iVacHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bVacC_Healthy THEN iVacHealthyCount := iVacHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iVacHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* True Median Select Logic *)
    IF ((rMeniscusVacuum_mbar >= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar) AND (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar <= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar)) OR
       ((rMeniscusVacuum_mbar <= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar) AND (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar >= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rMeniscusVacuum_mbar;
    ELSIF ((rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar >= rMeniscusVacuum_mbar) AND (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar <= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar)) OR

        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar;
    END_IF;
    tVacDiscrepancyTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1500MS);
ELSIF iVacHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Fail-Operational Mode: Compute Average of Pair *)
    IF bVacA_Healthy AND bVacB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := 0.5 * (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar + rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar);
    ELSIF bVacB_Healthy AND bVacC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := 0.5 * (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar + rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
    ELSE
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := 0.5 * (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar + rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
    END_IF;
    dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Vacuum Transducer Degraded 1oo2 *)
    tVacDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rDiffAbs > (rVacuumTolerance_mbar * 1.5)), PT := T#1500MS);
    IF tVacDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
        dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00002000; (* Bit 13: 2oo3 Vacuum Dual Divergence Trip *)

(* Convert Physical Parameters to SI Units *)

                           MAX(0.01, (rPrecursorSolidFraction * (rSolventDensity_kgm3 / MAX(1.0, rPerovskiteDensity_kgm3))));

(* Capillary Number: Ca = (mu * U_web) / sigma *)
IF rSurfaceTension_Nm > 0.001 THEN
    rCapillaryNumber := (rDynamicViscosity_Pas * rWebSpeed_ms) / rSurfaceTension_Nm;
ELSE
    rCapillaryNumber := 0.001;
END_IF;

(* Bead Reynolds Number: Re = (rho * U_web * H_G) / mu *)

END_IF;
rReynoldsNumberOut := rReynoldsNumber;

(* Weber Number: We = (rho * U_web^2 * H_G) / sigma *)
IF rSurfaceTension_Nm > 0.001 THEN
    rWeberNumber := (rSolventDensity_kgm3 * (rWebSpeed_ms * rWebSpeed_ms) * rDieGap_m) / rSurfaceTension_Nm;
ELSE
    rWeberNumber := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Ruschak-Higgins Viscous-Capillary Dynamic Meniscus Pressure Balance *)
(* Delta_P = (sigma/H_G) * [ 1.34 * Ca^(2/3) * (1 - t_wet/H_G)^(-1.5) - (H_G / R_curv) ] *)
IF (rDieGap_m > 0.000005) AND (rWetFilmThickness_m < (rDieGap_m * 0.85)) THEN
    rTempFloat := 1.0 - (rWetFilmThickness_m / rDieGap_m);
    IF rTempFloat < 0.15 THEN rTempFloat := 0.15; END_IF;
    (* Approximate Ca^(2/3) via Taylor series / exponential approximation *)
    rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar := ((rSurfaceTension_Nm / rDieGap_m) *
                                 (1.34 * EXPT(MAX(0.00001, rCapillaryNumber), 0.66667) *
                                  EXPT(rTempFloat, -1.5) - (rDieGap_m / MAX(0.000005, rMeniscusCurvatureRadius_m)))) * 0.01;
ELSE
    rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar := -4.50;
END_IF;
rMeniscusPressureDrop_mbar := rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar;

(* Dynamic Coating Window Boundaries *)
rCoatingWindowMinVac_mbar := rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar - 3.50; (* Air entrainment boundary *)
rCoatingWindowMaxVac_mbar := rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar + 4.20; (* Cavity weeping boundary *)

(* Verify Meniscus Stability Envelope *)
IF (rVotedVacuum_mbar >= rCoatingWindowMinVac_mbar) AND (rVotedVacuum_mbar <= rCoatingWindowMaxVac_mbar) AND
   (rDieLipMicroGap_um >= 15.0) AND (rDieLipMicroGap_um <= 100.0) THEN
    bCoatingBeadStable := TRUE;
ELSE
    bCoatingBeadStable := FALSE;
    IF (iMachineState = 80) THEN
        dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Meniscus Operating Outside Optimal Window *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.2: IN-SITU GAS-KNIFE QUENCHING & CRYSTALLIZATION FRONT DETECTION
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Gas Jet Reynolds Number: Re_jet = (rho_gas * v_gas * d_standoff) / mu_gas *)
IF rGasKinematicVisc_m2s > 0.000001 THEN
    rJetReynolds := (rGasKnifeVelocity_ms * (rGasKnifeStandoff_mm * 0.001)) / rGasKinematicVisc_m2s;
ELSE
    rJetReynolds := 1000.0;
END_IF;

(* Sherwood Number for Convective Mass Transfer: Sh = 0.023 * Re^0.8 * Sc^0.4 *)
rSherwoodNumber := 0.023 * EXPT(MAX(10.0, rJetReynolds), 0.8) * EXPT(rSchmidtNumber, 0.4);
rMassTransferCoeff_k := (rSherwoodNumber * 0.0000085) / MAX(0.001, (rGasKnifeStandoff_mm * 0.001));

(* Solvent Evaporation Flux [kg / (m^2 * s)] *)
rSolventEvapRate_kgm2s := rMassTransferCoeff_k * (rSatVaporPress_Pa / (8.314 * (rVotedBackingTemp_degC + 273.15)));

(* Supersaturation Ratio and Theoretical Crystallization Front Model *)
rSupersaturationRatio := 1.0 + (rSolventEvapRate_kgm2s * 125.0) / MAX(0.01, rWebSpeed_ms);
rCrystFrontModel_mm := 8.5 + (rWebSpeed_mmin * 1.85) / MAX(2.0, (rGasKnifeVelocity_ms * 0.12));

(* First-Order Exponential Filtering of Line-Scan Optical Crystallization Front *)
rFilteredCrystFront_mm := (rCrystFrontAlphaFilter * rCrystFrontObservedPos_mm) +
                          ((1.0 - rCrystFrontAlphaFilter) * rFilteredCrystFront_mm);
rCrystFrontPosition_mm := rFilteredCrystFront_mm;

(* Verify Crystallization Front Locking *)
IF (ABS(rFilteredCrystFront_mm - rTargetCrystFront_mm) <= 1.50) AND (rCrystFrontObservedPos_mm > 2.0) THEN
    bCrystFrontLocked := TRUE;
ELSE
    bCrystFrontLocked := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.3: DUAL-WAVELENGTH LASER CONFOCAL THIN-FILM METROLOGY
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Verify Optical Window Obscuration *)
IF rOpticalObscuration_pct > 75.0 THEN
    dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Laser Confocal Obscuration Critical *)
ELSIF rOpticalObscuration_pct > 40.0 THEN
    dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Optical Window Contamination Warning *)
END_IF;

(* Synthetic Vernier Wavelength Phase Disambiguation *)
(* Lambda_syn = (Lambda_1 * Lambda_2) / |Lambda_1 - Lambda_2| = 1117.17 nm *)
rPhaseDiff_rad := ATAN2(rLaser405nmIntensity_V, MAX(0.001, rLaser635nmIntensity_V));
IF rPhaseDiff_rad < 0.0 THEN
    rPhaseDiff_rad := rPhaseDiff_rad + 6.2831853;
END_IF;

(* Wet Film Thickness Reconstructed from Vernier Phase Angle *)
rConfocalWetThickness_nm := (rPhaseDiff_rad / 6.2831853) * (rSyntheticWavelength_nm / (2.0 * rEffectiveRefractiveIndex));

(* Dry Film Active Layer Thickness Reconstructed via Precursor Solid Volume Fraction *)
(* t_dry = t_wet * [ w_solid * (rho_sol / rho_perov) ] *)
rReconstructedDryThickness_nm := rConfocalFilmThickness_nm;
IF rReconstructedDryThickness_nm < 50.0 THEN
    rReconstructedDryThickness_nm := rConfocalWetThickness_nm *
                                    (rPrecursorSolidFraction * (rSolventDensity_kgm3 / MAX(1.0, rPerovskiteDensity_kgm3)));
END_IF;

rEstimatedDryThickness_nm := (rLaserThicknessAlphaFilter * rReconstructedDryThickness_nm) +
                             ((1.0 - rLaserThicknessAlphaFilter) * rEstimatedDryThickness_nm);
rFilmThicknessError_nm := rEstimatedDryThickness_nm - rTargetFilmThickness_nm;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 4: 5x5 STATE-SPACE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER & MULTIVARIABLE PROJECTED GRADIENT MPC
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* Pack Continuous Measurement Vector y[k] *)
vecMeas_y[1] := rEstimatedDryThickness_nm;      (* State 1 Meas: Dry film thickness [nm] *)
vecMeas_y[2] := rVotedVacuum_mbar;             (* State 2 Meas: Upstream meniscus vacuum [mbar] *)
vecMeas_y[3] := rFilteredCrystFront_mm;        (* State 3 Meas: Crystallization front pos [mm] *)
vecMeas_y[4] := rVotedTension_N;               (* State 4 Meas: Web tension [N] *)
vecMeas_y[5] := rDieLipMicroGap_um;            (* State 5 Meas: Lip coating gap [um] *)

(* Pack Target State Vector x_sp *)
vecTarget_x[1] := rTargetFilmThickness_nm;
vecTarget_x[2] := rTargetMeniscusVacuum_mbar;
vecTarget_x[3] := rTargetCrystFront_mm;
vecTarget_x[4] := rTargetWebTension_N;
vecTarget_x[5] := rTargetDieGap_um;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 4.1: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER MEASUREMENT UPDATE & TIME PROPAGATION
   1. Compute Innovation Residual: e[k] = y[k] - C * x_pred[k]
   2. State Correction Update:     x[k|k] = x_pred[k] + K * e[k]
   3. Time Propagation:            x_pred[k+1] = A * x[k|k] + B * u[k]
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matC[iRow, iCol] * vecState_x_pred[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecResidual_y[iRow] := vecMeas_y[iRow] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Kalman State Correction *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matK_Kalman[iRow, iCol] * vecResidual_y[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x[iRow] := vecState_x_pred[iRow] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Kalman Innovation Plausibility Boundary Check *)
IF (ABS(vecResidual_y[1]) > 80.0) OR (ABS(vecResidual_y[2]) > 4.0) THEN
    dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: Kalman Innovation Divergence Warning *)
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 4.2: CONSTRAINED MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZER
   Objective: Minimize J = (x - x_sp)^T * Q * (x - x_sp) + Delta_u^T * R * Delta_u
   Algorithm: Projected Gradient Descent with hard boundary clipping and slew limiting
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bAutoMPC_Enable AND (iMachineState = 80) AND (dwActiveAlarms = 16#00000000) THEN
    (* Initialize Input Candidate from Previous Cycle *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u_prev[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iIter := 1 TO iMpcMaxIterations DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
            rTempSum := 0.0;
            FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
                rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iRow, iCol] * vecWeight_Q[iRow] * (vecState_x[iRow] - vecTarget_x[iRow]));
            END_FOR;
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (vecWeight_R[iCol] * (vecInput_u[iCol] - vecInput_u_prev[iCol]));
            vecGradient_g[iCol] := rTempSum;
        END_FOR;

        (* Gradient Descent Step: u = u - alpha * g *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
            vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u[iCol] - (rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[iCol]);
            (* Slew Rate Clamping *)
            IF (vecInput_u[iCol] - vecInput_u_prev[iCol]) > vecDeltaU_Max[iCol] THEN
                vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u_prev[iCol] + vecDeltaU_Max[iCol];
            ELSIF (vecInput_u[iCol] - vecInput_u_prev[iCol]) < -vecDeltaU_Max[iCol] THEN
                vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u_prev[iCol] - vecDeltaU_Max[iCol];
            END_IF;
            (* Hard Actuator Saturation Clamping *)
            IF vecInput_u[iCol] > vecU_Max[iCol] THEN
                vecInput_u[iCol] := vecU_Max[iCol];
            ELSIF vecInput_u[iCol] < vecU_Min[iCol] THEN
                vecInput_u[iCol] := vecU_Min[iCol];
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Save Solution for Slew Regularization in Next Cycle *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        vecInput_u_prev[iCol] := vecInput_u[iCol];
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* Time Propagation for Next Scan: x_pred[k+1] = A * x[k|k] + B * u[k] *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matA[iRow, iCol] * vecState_x[iCol]) + (matB[iRow, iCol] * vecInput_u[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 5: SUB-NEWTON HIGH-SPEED WEB TENSION SYNCHRONIZATION & ACTIVE COMPLIANCE
   ================================================================================================= *)
(* Sub-Newton Tension Deviation & PI Controller with Anti-Windup *)
rTensionError_N := rTargetWebTension_N - rVotedTension_N;

IF (iMachineState >= 20) AND (iMachineState <= 100) THEN
    rTensionIntegral_N := rTensionIntegral_N + (rTensionKi * rTensionError_N * rCycleTime_s);
    (* Integral Anti-Windup Clamping *)
    IF rTensionIntegral_N > 0.40 THEN
        rTensionIntegral_N := 0.40;
    ELSIF rTensionIntegral_N < -0.40 THEN
        rTensionIntegral_N := -0.40;
    END_IF;
    rBackingRollVelocityTrim_mmin := (rTensionKp * rTensionError_N) + rTensionIntegral_N;
ELSE
    rTensionIntegral_N            := 0.0;
    rBackingRollVelocityTrim_mmin := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Sub-Newton Web Tension Precision Status Evaluation (+/- 0.05 N) *)
IF ABS(rTensionError_N) <= 0.05 THEN
    bWebTensionInSpec := TRUE;
ELSE
    bWebTensionInSpec := FALSE;
    IF (iMachineState = 80) THEN
        dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: Web Tension Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Apply Velocity Synchronization Trim to Backing Roll Output *)
rWebTensionTrim_N := rBackingRollVelocityTrim_mmin;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 6: 13-PHASE DETERMINISTIC MACHINE STATE SEQUENCING
   ================================================================================================= *)
CASE iMachineState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: UNINITIALIZED_BOOT *)
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        bCoatingBeadStable  := FALSE;
        bCrystFrontLocked   := FALSE;
        bInterlockActive    := FALSE;
        rPiezoGapCmd_um     := 2500.0;      (* Die parked in high safety clearance *)
        rVacuumValveCmd_pct := 0.0;
        rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin := 0.0;
        rPump2FlowCmd_mLmin := 0.0;
        rGasKnifeVelocityCmd_ms := 0.0;
        tBootDelay(IN := bSystemEnable AND bEmergencyStop, PT := T#2000MS);
        IF tBootDelay.Q THEN
            tBootDelay(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: HARDWARE_AUDIT_SELFTEST *)
        (* Audit Piezo Nanopositioner Zero, Laser Metrology Dark Signal, and RTDs *)
        IF (iVacHealthyCount >= 2) AND (iTensionHealthyCount >= 2) AND (iTempHealthyCount >= 2) AND
           (rEnclosureO2_ppm < 100.0) AND (rEnclosureH2O_ppm < 50.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 20;
        ELSIF (rEnclosureO2_ppm >= 100.0) OR (rEnclosureH2O_ppm >= 50.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 30; (* Jump to Inert Enclosure Purge *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: SUB_NEWTON_TENSION_RAMP *)
        (* Ramp Web Speed to Creep Speed (1.0 m/min) and Establish Sub-Newton Tension *)
        tTensionRampTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4000MS);
        IF bWebTensionInSpec AND tTensionRampTimer.Q THEN
            tTensionRampTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: ENCLOSURE_ENVIRONMENT_INERT *)
        (* Condition N2 Glovebox Enclosure: O2 < 10 ppm, H2O < 5 ppm, Backing Roll Temp to 45 deg C *)
        tEnclosureTimer(IN := (rEnclosureO2_ppm < 10.0) AND (rEnclosureH2O_ppm < 5.0) AND
                              (ABS(rVotedBackingTemp_degC - 45.0) < 1.0), PT := T#3000MS);
        IF tEnclosureTimer.Q THEN
            tEnclosureTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 40;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: DUAL_CAVITY_PRIMING_DEGASSING *)
        (* Continuous Degassing: Pump Perovskite Ink & Interlayer to Expel Micro-Bubbles *)
        rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin := 0.25;
        rPump2FlowCmd_mLmin := 0.05;
        tDegasTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5000MS);
        IF tDegasTimer.Q AND (rCavity1InletPressure_bar > 0.05) AND (rCavity1InletPressure_bar < 2.50) THEN
            tDegasTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 50;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: LIP_MICRO_APPROACH *)
        (* Piezo Nanopositioner Travel from Safe Park (2500 um) to Recipe Gap (45 um) *)
        rPiezoGapCmd_um := rTargetDieGap_um;
        tApproachTimer(IN := ABS(rDieLipMicroGap_um - rTargetDieGap_um) < 0.50, PT := T#2500MS);
        IF tApproachTimer.Q THEN
            tApproachTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 60;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: MENISCUS_FORMATION_PINNING *)
        (* Engage Upstream Vacuum Box and Ramp Cavity Pumps to Establish Liquid Bead *)
        rVacuumValveCmd_pct := 35.0;
        rPump1Feedforward_mLmin := (rCoatingWidth_m * (rWebSpeed_mmin / 60.0) * (rTargetFilmThickness_nm * 0.000000001) /
                                   MAX(0.01, (rPrecursorSolidFraction * (rSolventDensity_kgm3 / MAX(1.0, rPerovskiteDensity_kgm3))))) * 60000000.0;
        rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin := MAX(0.20, rPump1Feedforward_mLmin);
        rPump2FlowCmd_mLmin := rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin * 0.20;
        tMeniscusTimer(IN := bCoatingBeadStable, PT := T#3000MS);
        IF tMeniscusTimer.Q THEN
            tMeniscusTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 70;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: GAS_KNIFE_QUENCH_ENGAGE *)
        (* Ramp Nitrogen Quenching Jet to 18 m/s and Lock Crystallization Front *)
        rGasKnifeVelocityCmd_ms := 18.0;
        tQuenchTimer(IN := bCrystFrontLocked, PT := T#3500MS);
        IF tQuenchTimer.Q THEN
            tQuenchTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 80;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: FULL_CLOSED_LOOP_STEADY_STATE *)
        (* High-Yield Production: Full Multivariable MPC & Kalman Filter Active *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        IF bAutoMPC_Enable THEN
            rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin     := vecInput_u[1];
            rVacuumValveCmd_pct     := vecInput_u[2];
            rGasKnifeVelocityCmd_ms := vecInput_u[3];
            rPiezoGapCmd_um         := vecInput_u[5];
        ELSE
            (* Decoupled Feedforward PID Fallback *)
            rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin     := rPump1Feedforward_mLmin - (rFilmThicknessError_nm * 0.008);
            rGasKnifeVelocityCmd_ms := 18.0 + ((rFilteredCrystFront_mm - rTargetCrystFront_mm) * 0.45);
            rPiezoGapCmd_um         := rTargetDieGap_um;
        END_IF;

        (* Web Splice Marker Event Trigger *)
        IF bWebSpliceDetected THEN
            iMachineState := 100; (* Jump to Splice Jump Routine *)
        ELSIF bRecipeRampTrigger THEN
            iMachineState := 90;  (* Jump to Coordinated Speed Ramp *)
        ELSIF bPurgeAndFlushCmd THEN
            iMachineState := 110; (* Controlled Flush Shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: COORDINATED_SPEED_RAMP *)
        (* Coordinated Acceleration Ramp (e.g. 2.0 m/min -> 10.0 m/min) *)
        rPump1Feedforward_mLmin := (rCoatingWidth_m * (rWebSpeed_mmin / 60.0) * (rTargetFilmThickness_nm * 0.000000001) /
                                   MAX(0.01, (rPrecursorSolidFraction * (rSolventDensity_kgm3 / MAX(1.0, rPerovskiteDensity_kgm3))))) * 60000000.0;
        rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin     := rPump1Feedforward_mLmin;
        rGasKnifeVelocityCmd_ms := 12.0 + (rWebSpeed_mmin * 1.25);
        IF ABS(rWebSpeed_mmin - rTargetLineSpeed_mmin) < 0.10 THEN
            iMachineState := 80; (* Return to Closed Loop Steady State *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: SPLICE_JUMP_AND_REAPPROACH *)
        (* Rapid 500 um Retract to Clear Web Splice Tape, Then Re-Pin Meniscus *)
        rPiezoGapCmd_um := rTargetDieGap_um + 500.0;
        tSpliceJumpTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1200MS);
        IF tSpliceJumpTimer.Q AND (NOT bWebSpliceDetected) THEN
            tSpliceJumpTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rPiezoGapCmd_um := rTargetDieGap_um;
            iMachineState   := 60; (* Re-pin meniscus *)
        END_IF;

    110: (* STATE 110: CONTROLLED_SHUTDOWN_WASH *)
        (* Controlled Solvent Washdown & Nitrogen Die Lip Blow-Off *)
        rPiezoGapCmd_um         := 1500.0;
        rVacuumValveCmd_pct     := 0.0;
        rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin     := 0.0;
        rPump2FlowCmd_mLmin     := 1.50;    (* Flush cavity with pure DMF/DMSO solvent *)
        rGasKnifeVelocityCmd_ms := 5.0;
        tFlushTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#8000MS);
        IF tFlushTimer.Q THEN
            tFlushTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rPump2FlowCmd_mLmin := 0.0;
            iMachineState       := 0;
        END_IF;

    120: (* STATE 120: EMERGENCY_RETRACT_SAFE_TRIP *)
        (* Instantaneous Safety Retract (< 10 ms piezo stroke) & Vacuum Dump *)
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        bInterlockActive    := TRUE;
        rPiezoGapCmd_um     := 2500.0;
        rVacuumValveCmd_pct := 0.0;
        rPump1FlowCmd_mLmin := 0.0;
        rPump2FlowCmd_mLmin := 0.0;
        rGasKnifeVelocityCmd_ms := 0.0;
        rWebTensionTrim_N   := 0.0;
        tTripDebounceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1000MS);
        IF tTripDebounceTimer.Q THEN
            tTripDebounceTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 130;
        END_IF;

    130: (* STATE 130: POST_TRIP_LATCHED *)
        (* Latched Safety Lockout: Requires Operator Acknowledge Pushbutton *)
        bSystemReady     := FALSE;
        bInterlockActive := TRUE;
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEmergencyStop AND bSystemEnable THEN
            dwActiveAlarms        := 16#00000000;
            dwProcessWarnings     := 16#00000000;
            bLatchedHardwareFault := FALSE;
            iMachineState         := 0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Unknown State Trap: Safe Retract *)
        iMachineState := 120;
END_CASE;

IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
